root_cause_label: QEMU Binary Missing — 161 Steps Of Filesystem Search Without Compiling From Source
one_sentence_failure_summary: Upon finding qemu-system-x86_64 absent at step 2, the agent committed to an exhaustive filesystem search strategy for the missing binary rather than compiling QEMU 5.2.0 from source as required, spending all remaining 159 steps in fruitless search loops.
t_err_evidence: QEMU executable might have a different name or is not in the default PATH. I need to locate the correct QEMU binary
t_commit_evidence: The agent immediately locks into a search-only strategy at step 3 (find /usr/bin -name 'qemu-system-*'), never revisiting the option of installing or compiling QEMU. All subsequent 158 steps are variations of filesystem search, confirming the failing strategy is irreversibly committed.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge that the task environment required QEMU to be compiled from source (specifically QEMU 5.2.0, as referenced in the task description). Instead, it operated under the false assumption that a QEMU binary must be present somewhere on the filesystem under an unusual name, leading to an exhaustive search strategy that never succeeded.
